name: ai-error-retired-model
description: Error envelope for a retired model family (Gemini 1.5, retired 2025-09-24 per the message text). Distinct from unknown-model: production distinguishes never-existed from retired.

behavior.messageText: Gemini 1.5 models are retired as of September 24, 2025. Update to a newer model version. [Learn more.](https://firebase.google.com/docs/ai-logic/faq-and-troubleshooting#discontinued-models)
